summary: Iteration 51: Verified Status Page Theme (accent + logo) admin controls, public rendering, and Webhook On Incidents dispatch. Backend pytest (6/6 passed): PUT /api/admin/deploy/status-page accepts valid hex accent (persisted and echoed on GET admin + public), rejects invalid hex 'red' with 400; POST /api/admin/deploy/status-logo (multipart PNG) returns {ok:true, logo:<url>}, GET /api/status/logo returns image/* 200 when set and 404 after DELETE; /api/status/public and /api/status/public/component/platform include accent + logo fields; incident lifecycle (create -> update -> resolve) with webhook_url=https://httpbin.org/post issues httpx POSTs — backend logs show three POST https://httpbin.org/post 200 OK during the test, confirming _notify_incident_channels fires on all three events. Frontend UI (Playwright): logged in as admin, opened Admin -> Deployment; status-theme-row visible; theme-accent-hex #2ea043 + theme-accent-apply applied accent (persisted in public /status where Subscribe button computed backgroundColor = rgb(46,160,67) and the active uptime-window tab uses the same accent); theme-logo-upload (PNG) rendered theme-logo-preview (naturalWidth=8, visible) and 'Logo uploaded' toast visible; public /status status-logo visible with naturalWidth=8; component page /status/platform shows component-logo (naturalWidth=8, visible) and the component-back link is themed with the accent. theme-accent-clear + theme-logo-remove restored a clean state; post-cleanup /api/status/public returns accent='' logo=''. Invalid hex ('red') in the UI Apply also surfaced feedback (no accent update). Alert channels cleared. Manual TEST_ incident inc_3212132f5a was created and resolved during the webhook test — no manual test incidents remain investigating (only the pre-existing auto Email-delivery incident, which is legitimately degraded due to no email provider key in this env).
seed_data_creation: Created + fully cleaned up: transient manual incident inc_3212132f5a (opened, updated, resolved via API), a 1x1/8x8 test PNG logo (uploaded then removed), transient accent color #2ea043 (applied then cleared), and alert_channels webhook_url=https://httpbin.org/post (cleared). Final DB state verified: accent='', logo='', alert_channels empty, no residual TEST_ manual incidents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend .env has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://stitches-connect.preview.emergentagent.com — use this exact host (do NOT use demobackend.preview.emergentagent.com which shows 'Preview Unavailable' inactivity page). Login button selector: use page.locator('button:has-text("Sign In")').last — first .Sign In element is the tab toggle. Public /status page places the accent as backgroundColor on the Subscribe button + active uptime-window tab, and as color on the brand label + component-back link. Webhook dispatch to httpbin.org/post is fire-and-forget async; validate via backend log grep for 'httpx.*POST https://httpbin.org/post .* 200'. Email delivery remains legitimately degraded (auto-incident open) in this env — expected, not a bug.
